paper_metadata.title: A first-principles study on D022 precipitation phases of Ni-based superalloys with loading stress and high temperature

evidence.quote: A first-principles study on Ni-based superalloys is performed to estimate the properties of D022 structure Ni3X (Ni3Nb, Ni3Ta, Ni3V) phases and L12 structure Ni3Al phase with loading stress and high temperature.
